pages.text: $(bold)Taizang Field$(): all things return to one; all bear the crushing weight.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself; every target inside except the caster constantly endures $(bold)pressure$() - twice the pressure of the Anti-Gravity Mechanism's reversal field (growing with curse affinity/output).$(br2)How the pressure resolves: a target's pressure threshold is derived from its body size and max HP -$(li)Below the threshold: Slowness, at a higher level the closer it gets to the limit (I to V)$(li)Past the threshold: the non-bedrock blocks beneath its feet are crushed, the target is frozen, and it keeps taking curse damage (the further past the limit, the higher each hit)

$(bold)Unlike Execution$(): this domain's pressure $(green)can be resisted by the three New Shadow Style techniques$() - if a target wears one and has enough curse power, Mikoshi Kago / Falling Blossom / Simple Domain make it immune to the pressure (the technique still restricts its actions and keeps draining curse power by its own rules).$(br2)$(bold)Upkeep$(): drains radius x30 curse power per second and closes automatically when it runs out.$(br2)Large, high-HP targets hold out better against the pressure (their threshold is higher); small or low-HP targets are crushed and frozen first.
